intent: Dashboard loop: incremental rendering — unchanged polls no longer redraw the workspace (#38)
notes: `dashboard/views/loop.js`: selected-loop panel now renders a stable skeleton once per selection (`buildLoopSkeleton()` — header, blocked, prompts, controls, timeline, artifacts regions) and patches per region on each poll via `patchRegion()` + fingerprints (`headerFingerprint`, `blockedFingerprint`, `controlsFingerprint`, `artifactsFingerprint`). Snapshot `_state.render` is keyed to `_state.generation`/`selectedLoopId`; cleared on teardown and null status. Identical polls perform no main-panel DOM writes except a text-only countdown patch (`updateTimeRemaining()`), removing the visible flash.

Timeline: `updateTimeline()` appends strictly-new event cards when the prior tail event is unchanged (`eventKey()`), else redraws only `#loop-timeline`; card markup/wiring split into `eventCardHtml()` / `wireTimelineCards()`.

Artifacts: `renderArtifacts()` reconciles sections by `data-artifact` (`createArtifactSection()`), preserving expanded state and loaded content; on event-log change the mutable `plan.current.md` / `findings.current.md` refresh their summary and (if expanded) content in place. `fetchArtifact()` now uses `cache: "no-store"` so refreshes are real.

Review fix (whiteboard P1): artifact summary/body fetches carry a per-node request revision (`nextRequestRev()`); an older in-flight response for `plan.current.md` / `findings.current.md` can no longer overwrite newer content. Collapsed-refresh invalidates in-flight body fetches; expanded-but-still-loading sections are refetched. Test: `test_stale_mutable_artifact_response_cannot_overwrite_newer` (deferred route fulfilment; verified failing without the fix).

Removed the #40 `isComposingControl()` poll-skip: controls are only rebuilt when their inputs change, so an open control input survives polling by construction; terminal transitions patch in place (no blank panel) and stop polling.

Tests (`tests/test_dashboard_ui/test_loop_workspace.py`): identical polls touch nothing (node identity + MutationObserver), status change patches header while preserving timeline + expanded artifact, new events append and add artifacts without resetting expansion, composed control survives unrelated changes, terminal transition patches in place and stops polling. Verified the identical-poll and append tests fail against the previous loop.js.
Charter: `scripts-dashboard-ui.md` loop-workspace entry updated with the incremental-rendering contract (replaces the compose-guard note; drops stale `renderPromptCopy()` name).
